method: Exact GLTFLoader; all exported skin vertices at 60 Hz; SkeletonUtils clone; actual src/game/enemy-animation.ts; raycasts against the skinned opaque primitive from six gameplay camera azimuths (7.9 m out, 2.62 m high); antenna rod crossing tested against the posed brass port on every closed-dome frame. Rotation-only joints are checked as fixed local pivots; the hips, tongue, cockpit, pilot root and pilot head are the intentional translations. No physical-device or universal triangle-collision proof.
